MILEBOND_QC_FIRST_RUN_STANDARD: We perform 100% inspection on the first production run of a new project; repeat order inspection scope will be agreed separately per project.
MILEBOND_SUPPLIER_ASSESSMENT_LIMIT: Our free preliminary supplier assessment is based on available information and quotation review. It does not guarantee supplier capacity, production timelines, product quality, or future performance, and does not replace a paid factory audit.
MILEBOND_SOURCING_FEASIBILITY_LIMIT: Supplier availability, pricing, MOQ, production feasibility, and lead time depend on individual factories. We cannot guarantee that every project will meet a specific target cost, MOQ, or timeline.
MILEBOND_COMPLIANCE_RESPONSIBILITY: We can help collect and organize available supplier compliance documents, test reports, and material information. Product design, regulatory compliance, certification requirements, and final market compliance remain the responsibility of the brand owner or importer unless separately agreed in writing with a qualified compliance provider.
MILEBOND_SUPPLIER_QUALITY_RESPONSIBILITY: Milebond performs inspections based on the agreed inspection scope and standards. Product manufacturing quality responsibility remains with the relevant supplier or manufacturer, subject to the contractual terms of the project.
MILEBOND_SUPPLIER_CONFIDENTIALITY_LIMIT: Supplier details and pricing transparency are subject to applicable supplier confidentiality requirements and project agreements.
MILEBOND_COMPONENT_MOQ_STANDARD: MOQ is generally determined by each individual component factory, not by Milebond's assembly service.
MILEBOND_AMAZON_SERVICE_SCOPE: Milebond supports Amazon-related sourcing, supplier coordination, inspection, kitting, packaging, labeling preparation, and shipment preparation. We do not provide Amazon store operations, account management, advertising management, or marketplace account hosting.
